title: Analysis of the perioperative administration of antibiotics in patients with a history of penicillin allergy
summary: Patients receive antibiotics perioperatively to prevent wound infections. If a patient reports a penicillin allergy, the choice of medications is limited, named as reserve. The study examines how frequently each medication was administered and whether there have been any changes since the introduction of the PENFAST score.
conditions: Personal history of allergy to penicillin

interventions.name: Patients who reported a beta-lactam allergy and received perioperative antibiotic prophylaxis between 1 December, 2023, and 30 November, 2024 will be retrospectively assessed for the antibiotic administered and the occurrence of allergic reactions.

Patients who reported a beta-lactam allergy and received perioperative antibiotic prophylaxis between 1 December 2024 and 30 November 2025 will be retrospectively assessed for the antibiotic administered and the occurrence of allergic reactions.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All adult patients who underwent surgery between 1 December 2023 and 30 November 2025, who reported an allergy to penicillin and/or aminopenicillin as part of their pre-operative preparation, and who received perioperative antimicrobial prophylaxis will be screened.
Exclusion criteria:
none
